items.title: Tom Lellis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, July 31, 2007
items.q: it’s Superman. So I don’t know, but yeah. I just try — I aspire to write lyrics that I’m not embarrassed singing.

ctx.x: Absolutely. I like time constraints. They seem to crystallize things. The pressure’s on, okay, you know, maybe I can turn this rock, this piece of coal into a diamond, in that — it’s Superman. So I don’t know, but yeah. I just try — I aspire to write lyrics that I’m not embarrassed singing. That’s really the bottom line. ‘Cause I hear jazz specifically, you know, those bebop tunes and everything, I really have a problem with the lyrics in some jazz tunes.
